actualObservation.card:
Expanse of the Vapors

Scadrial’s subastral is a world of mist. Physical things look like misty figures, the planet’s water appears as rocky shore and ground, and land becomes a misty fluid that travellers cross by boat. Living beings and all metal glow brightly.
